business_summary: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells building materials in China. It operates through Light Building Material, Water-Proof Building Material, and Coatings and Building Material divisions. The company offers gypsum board products, such as fire-resistant, water-resistant, formaldehyde-removal, anti-cracking and anti-sagging, perforated, and phase-change gypsum boards; multifunctional, mineral wool, and fiber cement boards; light steel and T-grid studs; internal and exterior paintings; joint compound gypsum, binders, leveling putty, putty powder, and self-leveling gypsum; insulating materials, such as rock wool board and felt, and granulated wool; waterproof materials; flooring products, including commercial heterogeneous vinyl sheets, special and sports flooring, vinyl planks, homogeneous vinyl flooring, and ninyl composition tiles; and ceiling and partition accessories, as well as special tools, keels, and architectural and industrial coatings. It also provides interior wall systems, such as ordinary partition, fire- and water-resistant, sound absorption, CH stud shaft, and veneer wall systems; standard, functional, and decorative ceiling systems; and exterior wall systems. In addition, the company engages in the manufacturing and sale of mortar, architectural hardware, and paint; import and export of building materials; wastewater treatment; environmental protection technology consulting; waterproofing construction; and new material technology promotion services. Its products are used in public buildings, home decorations, renovation, subway tunnels, and industrial buildings. Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company was founded in 1979 and is based in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 건축자재를 제조 및 판매합니다. 경량 건축 자재, 방수 건축 자재, 코팅 및 건축 자재 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 내화성, 내수성, 포름알데히드 제거, 균열 방지 및 처짐 방지, 천공 및 상변화 석고보드와 같은 석고보드 제품을 제공합니다. 다기능, 미네랄 울, 섬유 시멘트 보드; 가벼운 강철 및 T 그리드 스터드; 내부 및 외부 그림; 이음화합물 석고, 결합제, 레벨링 퍼티, 퍼티 파우더 및 셀프 레벨링 석고; 암면판, 펠트, 입상울 등의 단열재; 방수재료; 상업용 이종 비닐 시트, 특수 및 스포츠 바닥재, 비닐 판자, 균질 비닐 바닥재 및 니닐 조성 타일을 포함한 바닥재 제품; 천장 및 칸막이 액세서리, 특수 도구, 용골, 건축 및 산업용 코팅. 또한 일반 칸막이, 방화 및 방수, 흡음, CH 스터드 샤프트 및 베니어 벽 시스템과 같은 내부 벽 시스템을 제공합니다. 표준, 기능
